page_title: ACM 2-2 SAS | AC Milan v Sassuolo 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Corner kick. AC Milan will have an opportunity.

90+6' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom right corner. Arijanet Muric is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
90+5' It's a throw-in for AC Milan.
90+3' AC Milan win a corner.

90+3' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
90+3' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) will replace Davide Bartesaghi.
90' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
88' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Sebastian Walukiewicz, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Cristian Volpato.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andrea Pinamonti as he is replaced by Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
85' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
84' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
84' The foul by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) was seen by Valerio Crezzini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
84' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
82' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Arijanet Muric punches the ball away.
82' Fouls committed – 9:12.
79' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
77' 2 - 2 Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
76' Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.

75' A lofted cross from Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
73' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
73' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
72' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
71' 5:1 – the corner kicks stats.
69' The linesman signals a throw-in for AC Milan.
68' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for AC Milan due to an offside in the build-up play.
68' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Valerio Crezzini is going to take a look using VAR.
67' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
66' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card.
65' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
62' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mike Maignan with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
60' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Matteo Gabbia leaves the pitch to be replaced by Koni De Winter (AC Milan).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josh Doig (Sassuolo) replaces Fali Cande.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) will be replaced by Armand Lauriente.
57' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo).
57' Goal, no wait, AC Milan have a goal disallowed due to a foul.
57' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
57' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
57' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
56' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
56' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
54' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
53' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sassuolo.
50' The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
49' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
47' 2 - 1 Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
46' Valerio Crezzini interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
45+2' A player from Sassuolo takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
44' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' The game is interrupted now, Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
44' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' A clumsy foul by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) and Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle.
38' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
37' Total attempts – 5:2.
34' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box from Ruben Loftus-Cheek and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
34' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is caught offside!

29' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Arijanet Muric anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
29' There's an opportunity for Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

28' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Sassuolo manage to earn a corner.
28' Luka Modric (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Valerio Crezzini signals.
26' The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
23' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
23' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
22' The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.

22' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
20' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' A player from Sassuolo pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
16' Poor challenge! Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) is penalised for tripping and Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle.
15' Luka Modric (AC Milan) is about to take a corner kick.
13' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Mike Maignan and into the net. 0:1.
12' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
9' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' Fali Cande (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
4' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Valerio Crezzini blows the whistle, Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul.
1' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Valerio Crezzini was nominated as the referee for this game.
